_help: Settings for scripts/generate_voice.py. Replace every SET_ME before generating. Voice names under 'voices' must match the 'Voice:' lines in 03-script.md. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
_pause_help: How [pause] and [long pause] are sent. Ellipses work on every model. Models that support break tags (e.g. eleven_multilingual_v2, eleven_flash_v2_5) can use "<break time=\"1.0s\" />" instead. Eleven v3/v4 do not support break tags.
_stitch_help: true sends the neighbouring scenes of the same voice as previous_text/next_text, which smooths tone between scene files. Leave false until the chosen model is confirmed to support it.
